item.title: Alabama football REPORT CARD! 📝 Is Bama READY for Kamario Taylor?!
item.author: Alabama Crimson Tide on AL.com
item.description:
Break out the red pens! A quarter of the 2026 regular season is already over. Alabama has faced and defeated four opponents, two from the SEC. So how have they looked so far? Has Keelon Russell lived up to the hype? Have the run game and offensive line improved? Is Kane Wommack's defense one of the best in the nation, as expected? AL.com's Matt Stahl joins Ben Flanagan to hand out grades for everyone, including Kalen DeBoer in his third year as the Alabama head coach.
